scope: Published men’s and women’s schedules across Divisions I, II and III. Division I rows are evaluated against the badge renderer; lower divisions are checked against the school directory, official fixtures and NCAA artwork endpoints. Source-row counts can include repeated games on both teams’ schedules.
image_check: New mappings use school identities from the NCAA school index or school athletics sites with an image response. An unresolved source label is not necessarily a school. Source availability can change.
